title: Eight Hurt In Two Fannin Accidents
text:
Eight Hurt In Two Fannin Accidents

BONHAM — Eight persons were hospitalized in two separate wrecks in Fannin County over the weekend with five cars involved in the two accidents.

Seven persons were sent to the hospital as the result of a three-car accident on Highway 78 just north of the Bonham city limits and the eighth suffered only minor injuries at Savoy.

In the Savoy accident, C. G. Elliott, Jr. of Windom apparently went to sleep at the wheel of his car and ran off the road and plowed into a parked car belonging to George Feagan of Savoy. Feagan's car was demolished but Elliott escaped with only minor injuries.

The accident happened at 4:30 a.m. Easter Sunday.

Painful but not critically injured in the three-car accident at Bonham were Mrs. Raymond Fitzpatrick of Yuba and Mrs. Sidney Hicks of Bonham. Both suffered cuts about the face, head and body.

Others injured were Raymond Fitzpatrick, Sidney Hicks, Betty Wright and Glen Hamby, all of Yuba, and Tom Vaught, Jr. of Ravenna.

Fitzpatrick was heading south to Bonham from Yuba and Vaught was going north, according to of[ficials].

[Photo caption:] SAVOY PARKED CAR WRECKED—This is all that is left of George Feagan's car after it was rammed by a vehicle driven by C. G. Elliott of Windom. Feagan's car was parked at Savoy and Elliott went to sleep at the wheel of his car. He was only slightly injured. (Photo by Jimmy Reynolds, 13, Herald carrier-agent at Savoy)
